tables.description:
AMI is calculated by taking the "Median Family Income" set by HUD, 
and assuming that is equal to a Household Size = 4.

Household Size adjustments are based on the following table as set by HUD
1 person = 70%
2 people = 80%
3 people = 90%
4 people = {Median Family Income}
5 people = 108% (an additional 8% added for each additional household member)
6 people = 116%
7 people = 124%
8 people = 132%
